independent_check.source_fidelity: Freshly viewed frozen source physical p.16 Appendix C Eqs.(9)-(13), including the explicit definitions after Eq.(13); read p.7 Section 4.5 Method linking central fits to Appendix C.
independent_check.operative_assumptions: Positive E,A,B,N,D and positive exponents in the counterexamples; N,D retain the count interpretation from Eq.(9)/(11), and L^(i) denotes achieved loss. No parameter tying. Initialization grid is not a constraint on the optimum.
independent_check.independent_reasoning: Taking exp of Eq.(12) gives E+A exp(-alpha N)+B exp(-beta D), not the Eq.(9) power law. Fresh evaluation of both original examples and N=16,D=25,A=B=2,E=3 confirms mismatch. For one y=2 observation, the printed residual is zero at L=exp(2), whereas the feasible exact fit L=2 has positive Huber loss. This is an objective defect even after repairing Eq.(12).
independent_check.counterevidence_and_alternatives: An implicit log-coordinate convention would repair the formulas only by changing their explicit definitions. Published close fits and multiplicative central laws make the historical implementation uncertain; no code or raw-grid consequence is inferred.
independent_check.dependency_and_severity: Retain Major solely for invalid written derivation underpinning Section 4.5 coefficient estimation and additive comparisons. The numerical fit quality, mitigation observations and training pipeline are not refuted.
independent_check.repair_scope: Inserting log N, log D and log observed L restores the exact log-sum-exp identity and coherent log residual. It does not verify the optimizer, model fit or empirical coefficients; raw losses and fit implementation remain necessary.

limitations: No author implementation or raw fitting data
repair_verification: Exact identities and finite diagnostic only
